facts: Parties: Orwell Marine Ltd (Buyer), Marlow Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Calloway Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 16 June 2027; Closing is scheduled for 1 September 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 24 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 48 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 9.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 25% of the Purchase Price, being $10,125,000. The Purchase Price is $45,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
